CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   C. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.

   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold

   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
